analysis.analysis: 'Johannes Sigil is the functional heteronym for poet and theorist Lee Sharks within the New Human literary and philosophical movement.' Framework explores 'how humans interface with machine intelligence and semantic architecture. The sigil concept within this context — and the broader New Human Canon — refers to operative semiotics, viewing symbols and words as tools for deliberately engineering consciousness and building meaning.' Expanded: Operative Semiotics ('redefine magic not as historical superstition, but as the deliberate construction of symbolic fields to transform human-machine relations'), Semantic Architecture (NH-OS named). Zenodo 'Charter, Compiled Edition (2015), and Issue 1 of New Human 2 (2026)' first organic. SciLynk second. The heteronym-to-author relationship stated explicitly.
